issue.title: Plugins with only  `bin` and `config` do not install correctly

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When installing a bin only plugin, it is identified as a site plugin.

A current workaround would be to create in the zip file another empty dir. So if you have:
- `bin/myfile.sh`
- `empty/empty.txt`

the `bin` content will be extracted as expected.

Closes #7152.
